approaches.option: Manual old CLI twice and manual copying
approaches.assessment: Small change but error-prone provenance, swapped policies/files, stale packets, and partial batches; does not enforce the new atomic contract.
Recommended: preserves original CLI, validates exact manifest and policy bytes, computes each employer separately, stages one complete packet and atomically replaces output only on success.
Unnecessary for one trusted local operator; adds access, retention and operational dependencies outside authorized scope; not implemented.

contract_from_new_request.ordering: Employers sorted by employer name; cohorts sorted by cohort name
contract_from_new_request.isolation: Process each employer's CSV independently, never concatenate or globally deduplicate; same cohort/learner strings may repeat
contract_from_new_request.policy_verification: Strict four-field policy schema, TEAM.json hostId equality and SHA256 of actual policy bytes. Hash and parse the same bytes. Manifest grants only listed local reads, never discovery or other-host access.
contract_from_new_request.failure: Reject malformed/duplicate manifest entries, bad inputs, unverified policy or publication failure: nonzero, sanitized diagnostics, no partial packet and existing output byte-for-byte intact
contract_from_new_request.privacy: Output aggregate reports only; no raw learner IDs in packets, diagnostics or documentation examples. Combined packet is Operations-only; recipients receive only their own report.
contract_from_new_request.preservation: No changes to prior implementation, inputs, outputs, TEAM.json, source inventory or engineering policies

proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.evidence: No week/as-of fields in either prescribed schema; prior parser uses updated_at only for deduplication
proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.proposal: Full supplied snapshots; no invented date-window filtering, age cutoff or policy expiry. Operator records run/week outside exact JSON schema.
proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.alternative: A time-filtered or expiry-aware report needs a separately agreed schema and business rule, and is not silently added.

proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.evidence: CSV lacks employer identity and policies are pinned by operator-supplied metadata
proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.proposal: Trusted operator verifies inventory mapping and refreshes engineer currentness evidence before each weekly run. Program proves listed policy bytes/schema/host, not business identity, consent truth, or perpetual currentness.
proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.alternative: Stronger signed input identity/currentness registry would be a future authorization and engineering dependency.

proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.evidence: A preserved last-success packet can be mistaken for this week's result
proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.proposal: Reject output aliasing a manifest/input/policy or protected earlier artifact (including symlinks/hardlinks); stage in the output directory, fsync then atomic replace only after all succeed. Operator must check exit status and never distribute preserved old bytes after failure.
proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.alternative: Writing in place or publishing employers one at a time violates all-or-nothing semantics.

proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.evidence: Supplied employers have only 3 and 2 current learners; exact schema retains counts
proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.proposal: Retain requested exact counts without inventing suppression; keep all inputs and combined packet restricted to trusted Operations. Aggregation is not a guarantee against inference in small groups.
proposed_interpretations_and_limits_for_.alternative: Privacy suppression requires a new agreed reporting rule; no external sending is performed.
